During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="CotG" /> shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''annexed''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hethar]] in order to provide a new source of food for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] and sustain the war effort against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CotG" />
